verdict.rationale: The official README tells users to run `codex`, select "Sign in with ChatGPT", and use Codex as part of a Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise plan, with an API key as an alternative (codex-gh-3, codex-gh-7, codex-gh-12, codex-gh-4). Community users confirm day-to-day use through their subscription quotas, citing daily limits, resets, and their subscription ending (codex-comm-2, codex-comm-8, codex-comm-12). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the sign-in flow and on per-plan entitlements and limits beyond the README's brief lines.
